title: The Pessimistic farmer before the rains
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：pessimistic　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pessimistic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the fisherman wrote of ① a pessimistic farmer before the rains in the logbook, and everybody in the harbour said at once that it was ② more pessimistic than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the fisherman, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the pessimistic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most pessimistic farmer before the rains anybody in the harbour had ever seen, or so the logbook for July 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too pessimistic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the boatman who had come to help; the pessimistic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a pessimistic forecast for the harvest, and said that no boatman in his right mind would call it ⑥ as pessimistic as the forecast for the harvest they had once had in the old harbour. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was pessimistic or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something pessimistic, and nothing besides. The boatman from the next harbour called the whole plan ⑧ quite pessimistic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the logbook kept the names of the pessimistic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, before dawn, she wrote of another pessimistic farmer before the rains in the same logbook, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more pessimistic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most pessimistic forecast for the harvest in the whole harbour, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the pessimistic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 悲观（前置定语 a pessimistic farmer before the rains：1949 年渔人在航海日志里记下的那件悲观的农夫）
B. adj. 悲观／悲观主义（比较级 more pessimistic than：文中两处，一处比雨季前悲观的农夫，一处比预想）
C. adj. 悲观／悲观主义（最高级 the most pessimistic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 悲观（表语 too pessimistic to do：母亲觉得它太悲观，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 悲观主义（前置定语 a pessimistic forecast for the harvest：叔叔把整件事称作一桩悲观主义的悲观预计）
F. adj. 悲观主义（同级比较 as pessimistic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对收成的悲观预计相比）
G. adj. 悲观主义（后置定语 something pessimistic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 悲观主义（受程度副词修饰 quite pessimistic：那位船工的评价）

items.q: a pessimistic farmer before the rains
the most pessimistic farmer before the rains anybody
a pessimistic forecast for the harvest
The most pessimistic forecast for the harvest in

answers.why: pessimistic 意为“悲观”，1949 年渔人在航海日志里记下的是“一件悲观的农夫”，此处作前置定语 a pessimistic farmer before the rains。
pessimistic 意为“悲观”，此处用比较级 more pessimistic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
pessimistic 意为“悲观”，航海日志上 七月 那行字说它是渔港里最悲观的一件，故用最高级 the most pessimistic farmer before the rains。
pessimistic 意为“悲观”，母亲认为这件东西“太悲观了，谁也用不上”，too pessimistic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
pessimistic 意为“悲观主义”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩悲观主义的悲观预计”，此处作前置定语 a pessimistic forecast for the harvest。
pessimistic 意为“悲观主义”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对收成的悲观预计一样悲观主义”，同级比较用 as pessimistic as。
pessimistic 意为“悲观主义”，航海日志上那半行字要的是“悲观主义的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something pessimistic。
pessimistic 意为“悲观主义”，邻渔港来的那位船工认为这套计划“相当悲观主义”，quite 修饰原级 pessimistic。
pessimistic 意为“悲观主义”，1959 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要悲观主义”，故用比较级 more pessimistic than。
pessimistic 意为“悲观主义”，母亲 1961 年说的是“整个渔港里最悲观主义的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most pessimistic forecast for the harvest。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，渔人在航海日志里记下了一件悲观的农夫。（a pessimistic farmer before the rains）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更悲观。（more pessimistic than …）
母亲觉得它太悲观，谁也用不上。（too pessimistic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩悲观主义的悲观预计。（a pessimistic forecast for the harvest）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对收成的悲观预计一样悲观主义。（as pessimistic as …）
到了 1956 年，航海日志上只剩半行字：要的是一件悲观主义的东西。（something pessimistic）
answers: In 1949 the fisherman wrote of a pessimistic farmer before the rains in the logbook.
Everybody said it was more pessimistic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too pessimistic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a pessimistic forecast for the harvest.
He said nobody would call it as pessimistic as the forecast for the harvest they had once had.
By 1956 the logbook asked for nothing but something pessimistic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pessimistic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the fisherman wrote of a pessimistic farmer before the rains in the logbook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most pessimistic farmer before the rains in the harbour, or so the logbook says.
My mother thought it too pessimistic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a pessimistic forecast for the harvest, and nobody argued with him.
The boatman from the next harbour called the plan quite pessimistic, and everybody laughed.
The pessimistic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
